test_title: SSC CGL Tier-II (AAO) 2023 Official Paper-III (Held On: 27 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In relation to methods of economic study, which of the following statements is INCORRECT?

options.text: Inductive method is also known as historical method 'or' statistical method.
Deductive method is a static analysis, inductive method is dynamic.
Deductive method is also called prior method, abstract method and analytical method.

solution:
The correct answer is** Modern economists follow deductive method.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Modern economists follow deductive method:**

 
 
• This statement is incorrect. Modern economists often use both inductive and deductive methods. The inductive method involves deriving general principles from specific observations, while the deductive method involves deducing specific predictions from general principles.
 
• In practice, economists may start with a theory (deductive) and then test it with real-world data (inductive), or they may observe data patterns and formulate theories based on those observations.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Inductive method is also known as historical method or statistical method:**

 
 
• This statement is correct. The inductive method involves gathering data and observations to form general principles or theories, often using historical or statistical analysis.
 
 
 
• **Deductive method is a static analysis, inductive method is dynamic:**
 
 
• This statement is correct. The deductive method often involves static analysis where conclusions are derived from established theories. The inductive method, being based on observation and data collection, is more dynamic and adaptable to new information.
 
 
 
• **Deductive method is also called prior method, abstract method and analytical method:**
 
 
• This statement is correct. The deductive method is often referred to by these names because it involves reasoning from general principles or theories (prior knowledge) to specific instances.
